# True Diet — Codebase Audit

> Status: development phase. This document is the source-of-truth audit of the existing
> React Native / Expo application plus its Hono + Drizzle backend.
> No application code was modified to produce it.

## 1. Headline findings

- The brief references "38 screens." The codebase registers **56 route names** rendered by
  **26 components**. **29 routes are generated by two generic templates**
  (`ExtendedScreen` and a placeholder factory).
- **Onboarding data is never persisted.** Screens `Goal`, `PersonalDetails`, `Allergies`,
  `DietaryPreferences` write only to in-memory React context (`OnboardingContext`). The backend
  has a working `POST /api/profile` that the app **never calls**.
- **Auth is the only real integration.** All other feature groups have no API or DB layer.
- Auth base URL is **`http://localhost:3000`** — intentionally unchanged for development.
  Must become HTTPS before any device/store build (documented as a pre-production TODO only).

## 2. Architecture map

```
App.tsx
└─ AuthProvider > OnboardingProvider > NavigationContainer > RootNavigator
   ├─ "Onboarding" -> AppNavigator (native-stack, headerShown:false)
   │    Welcome -> Goal -> PersonalDetails -> Allergies -> DietaryPreferences
   │    -> BuildingProfile (auto-advance) -> AccountSetup -> NutritionProfile
   └─ "Main" -> MainNavigator (native-stack)
        └─ MainTabs (bottom-tabs): Home · Learn · Track · Resources · Profile
        + 44 pushed stack routes
```

- **State:** `AuthContext` (Better Auth session), `OnboardingContext` (in-memory only).
  No global data layer, caching, or persistence.
- **Network calls:** `authClient.signUp.email` / `signIn.email` (`AccountSetupScreen.tsx`),
  `authClient.getSession` (`AuthContext.tsx`). Nothing else.
- **Everything else:** local state + `Alert.alert`.

## 4. Reconciling "38" vs. actual

- Dedicated screens (R): 24
- Generic template screens (T): ~27 (one layout, swapped copy)
- Placeholder stubs (P): 2 (`Topic`, `Article`)
- Mock auth screens (M): 4 (`Login`/`CreateAccount`/`ForgotPassword`/`ResetConfirmation`,
  text says "This will use Supabase Auth once connected" — contradicts real Better Auth)
- Navigation host: `MainTabs`

Treat the codebase as source of truth; the "38" does not match the implementation.

## 5. Backend API inventory

Stack: Hono + Drizzle + PostgreSQL + Better Auth (Expo plugin). Entry `server/src/index.ts`.

| Method | Route | Auth | Status | Used by app? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` | none | OK | No |
| POST/GET | `/api/auth/**` | — | Better Auth | Yes |
| GET | `/api/profile` | session | OK | No |
| POST | `/api/profile` | session | OK | No |

Missing groups (no endpoint): content/articles, resources, recipes/ingredients, food search,
food logs/meals, progress summaries, saved items, dietitian profiles/availability, appointments,
secure messaging, notifications, user preferences, subscriptions/entitlements, webhooks.

## 6. Database audit

Present tables (`server/src/db/schema.ts`): `user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`, `profile`.

- All auth relations use `onDelete: "cascade"`.
- `profile` holds age/sex/height/weight/goal/allergies/dietaryPreferences/isAssessmentComplete.
- `verification` is not FK-linked to `user` (delete-token cleanup caveat).

Missing tables: content, recipes, recipe_ingredients, food_logs, check_ins, saved_items,
appointments, messages, notifications, preferences, subscriptions.

## 8. Store compliance blockers

1. No data persistence for assessments/food/progress.
2. Onboarding never calls `POST /api/profile`.
3. Mock auth duplicates contradict real Better Auth.
4. 29 templated/placeholder routes would fail Apple 2.1 / Google completeness.
5. No API/DB for 12+ feature groups; no subscription/entitlement foundation.
6. Auth URL is `http://localhost:3000` (**kept intentionally for dev**; must be HTTPS pre-release).
7. In-app account deletion not implemented (required by Apple + Google).
8. No privacy-policy URL (required by both stores).
9. `Checkout` routes digital membership to Stripe (must be Apple IAP + Google Play Billing).
10. Health data (age/sex/height/weight/allergies) collected without a consent step.

## 9. Recommended sequencing

1. Persist onboarding: call `POST /api/profile` from `BuildingProfile`/`AccountSetup`; `GET /api/profile`
   on Screen 9 / profile settings. Add resume support.
2. Implement account deletion (Better Auth `user.deleteUser.enabled` + screen) — see design notes.
3. Consolidate auth onto Better Auth; remove mock `AuthScreen`.
4. Build content/recipes/logs/services APIs + DB, replacing hardcoded data.
5. Decide free-vs-premium boundaries; add IAP (RevenueCat) for digital; keep Stripe for 1:1 services only.
6. Store readiness: icon/splash, bundle ids, `eas.json`, privacy policy URL, data-safety forms.
